purpose: Promotional itch.io page artwork; not gameplay screenshots
prompts: Use case: ads-marketing. Create one finished beautiful itch.io game page BANNER for the original indie game AFTERPARTY. Wide landscape 3:1 aspect ratio, target 1536x512. Cohesive premium illustrated indie-game key art, rounded geometric forms, soft paper-like gouache texture, restrained luminous accents, flat readable shapes, carefully composed rather than photorealistic or shiny 3D. Palette: midnight navy #111626, creamy sage #dfe6bf, mint #b9eb9c, warm honey wood #dab58f, dusty coral #ca919c and teal #6d8887. Scene: a single cozy living room after a leaving party, at night just before dawn. On the right a small adorable round cleaning robot with cream shell, dark teal visor and two tiny mint eyes vacuums a few paper napkins, pink cups and golden crumbs. Behind it a teal sofa with a fully clothed sleeping host under a dusty coral blanket, warm fairy lights and a few bunting flags. A coffee table and cake remnants imply the party, small details not visual clutter. Navy negative space on the left supports large immaculate legible cream typography: exact title 'AFTERPARTY' (A F T E R P A R T Y) and beneath it exact tagline 'A tiny robot. A very big mess.' Title placed safely within the middle left, with generous margins. Polished deliberate editorial layout. Keep the robot silhouette clean and memorable. No UI, no gameplay counters, no browser chrome, no logos except the original title, no watermark, no extra text.

Use case: ads-marketing. Create one finished itch.io PAGE BACKGROUND for the original indie game AFTERPARTY. Landscape 16:9 aspect ratio, target 1920x1080. Match a premium illustrated cozy indie game: rounded geometric shapes, subtle paper-like gouache texture, gentle graphic lighting, no realism or glossy 3D. Palette primarily midnight navy #111626 and slightly lighter indigo #1c253b, with tiny sparse accents of creamy sage, mint #b9eb9c, dusty coral and honey gold. A quiet atmospheric abstract impression of a single living room after a party. IMPORTANT: the central 65% of the image must be almost empty smooth dark navy, low contrast and free of recognizable objects, so an itch.io game page and text can sit on top. Only at the distant outer edges and corners: a delicate hanging string of very small dim warm fairy lights, a few paper confetti scraps and tiny bunting shapes, soft partial silhouettes of plants and the rim of a wooden floor at the bottom corners. Restrained and elegant, soft vignette, very sparse detail, a tranquil late-night atmosphere. All objects must remain peripheral, no main character and no scene in the center. No text, no lettering, no title, no interface, no play button, no watermark.
